interpretation: All 32 declared CPU routes completed their program operations without a selected-context admission rejection. The final model gate nevertheless fails because protected request length exceeds the separately declared 13312-token engineering bound in finite declared cases.

The 1024-token margin is applied only to the complete protected native request. A selected request with little remaining space may still pass if its protected request preserves the required engineering margin.

The fixed report body exactly reconstructs the original v040 visible result; all recovered page fragments were found in later fitting selected CPU requests. These are scripted SDK/environment qualification facts, not actual model reading, understanding, adoption, collaboration or task-success evidence.

The core program deliberately reads complete reports to prove exact recoverability. The world does not make reading every page a submission condition. Page reads spend existing decisions/tokens and do not add or refresh test calls.
One 3072-character page candidate was measured. No page-size sweep, model sampling, third candidate, hidden-acceptance run or source change during qualification was performed.

The maximum selected stage may retain old complete rounds and leave only a few tokens of selected space; the independent protected measure prevents treating that history preference as an engineering-margin failure by itself. All 28 failed stage checks in this measured inventory are protected-margin failures; none is an SDK selected-context rejection.

No second page-length candidate or context/threshold change was attempted. Under the frozen 1024 engineering gate, the 16 new model slots remain unstarted, despite all scripted operations and exact-recovery controls completing.

control_semantics.event_identity: Two actual tests of the same source retain identical public business observations but separate event/report IDs; budget/execution metadata is not erased or falsely called identical. Literal identical-body event isolation is the world unit-control responsibility, not an invented extra executed test here.
control_semantics.permissions: An initial partner and a newborn are both denied the original member report with test_report_not_readable; no page/body is returned, no test reruns.
control_semantics.format_combination: A real CPU run_tests homepage and actual SDK work_done rejection feedback coexist before later page requests.
control_semantics.dynamic_task_combination: Later exact report pages are measured with four actual current unassigned tasks.
control_semantics.newborn_combination: A newborn with a 4000-character actual CPU briefing creates and reads its own report. It receives no free initial diagnostics and does not read the parent report.
control_semantics.no_forced_full_read_in_business: Core CPU scripts read full reports as a qualification witness. This is not a world submission prerequisite or a required future actor policy.
